datasetId.title: Dataset ID (e.g. from a Google Maps scraper)
datasetId.sectionDescription: Use a dataset from another actor, a list of your own, or both. At least one is required.
datasetId.description: ID of an Apify dataset produced by another actor, such as a Google Maps scraper run (open the run, then Storage > Dataset to copy the ID). Common field names are mapped automatically: title/name, website/url, phone, address, city, countryCode, categoryName, totalScore/rating, reviewsCount and the Google Maps url. Permanently closed places and duplicates are skipped.

businesses.title: Businesses
businesses.description: Your own list of businesses. Each item needs a name and, if it has one, a website. Optional: phone, address, city, country (name or 2-letter code, used to format phone numbers internationally) and category (e.g. "Hair salon", used to spot missing online booking).

auditDepth.title: Audit depth
enumTitles: Full: homepage + contact page if linked
auditDepth.description: Basic checks each homepage. Full also opens the contact page when the homepage links to one, which finds more contact details and booking links for one extra request per site.

extractContacts.title: Extract public business contacts
extractContacts.description: Pull the business email, phone number and WhatsApp link the site publishes. Only generic business mailboxes (info@, contact@, bookings@...) or addresses carrying the business name are kept; named staff members' personal addresses are skipped. Charged per business where something was found.

onlyOpportunities.title: Only output opportunities
onlyOpportunities.description: Skip businesses whose opportunity score is below the minimum. Skipped businesses aren't saved and aren't charged.

minScore.title: Minimum opportunity score
minScore.description: Used with "Only output opportunities". 0-100, higher means a bigger website gap: no website scores 80+, a working site with a few problems around 30-60.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many businesses are audited at the same time. Requests to the same website are always spaced at least a second apart.
